observed_owner_defects: An exception during inventory, staging, oracle construction, worker launch, retrieval, or repair setup escapes the outer try. finally writes classification unknown, stops heartbeat ownership, and does not release or publish an executable repair boundary.
A repair-deadline or absolute-deadline terminal exits without a generation-fenced release to maintenance, leaving a claimed bench without a live heartbeat owner.

No project-relative entrypoint atomically claims the bench, derives the post-claim binding fields, launches the controller-host durable owner, and publishes active_session only after a dynamic ready marker.

owner_repair: Keep one live outer dispatcher across every recoverable controller, staging, API, retrieval, and classification exception. Persist a noncanonical diagnostic, publish a fresh repair generation, wait while heartbeating, consume the request immutably, and re-enter candidate_only.
Release ready only after a decision-bearing 32-response terminal satisfying the packet evidence contract.
At the absolute deadline, persist a typed unconsumed boundary and release with gpu_pool release --expected-claimed-at <binding claimed_at> --condition maintenance before owner exit.
For a proven unsafe or unreachable guest, persist the diagnostic and generation-fenced release to maintenance. Do not release on an ordinary recoverable exception while execution time remains.
delegation.launcher_repair: Add one project-relative launcher that reads the exact current bench, atomically claims it, derives ENDPOINT_R5_EXECUTION_BINDING.json with claimed_at, release deadline, checkpoint path, remote root, immutable control root/hash, GPU UUID, SSH fingerprint, and watchdog PID, then starts run_fixed_floor_crossop_endpoint_owner_r5.py through controller-host detached-owner --unit-manager pid. Publish STATUS.json.active_session only after a fresh generation-specific ready file proves the owner crossed claim/binding validation into staging or candidate_only.
delegation.validation: Exercise the owner with bounded local fake-command fixtures proving recoverable exception -> repair wait/re-entry, decision terminal -> ready release, deadline -> maintenance release with expected claimed_at, and no unconditional release on recoverable failure. Exercise the launcher against a fake pool/detached-owner boundary; do not claim the real bench.
delegation.publication_order: Finish and validate owner, launcher, packet, and offline binding; compute final hashes; publish R5_OWNER_REPAIR_VALIDATION.json and matching paused/claim-disallowed STATUS.json last.

lifecycle_disposition.if_outputs_become_durable: Pause claim-disallowed and request an immediate director execution binding. The next director must compare remaining restart, terminal, and release time before activation.
lifecycle_disposition.if_outputs_are_not_durable_in_time: Keep the bench unclaimed and allow exact-ID watchdog cleanup at 06:20Z. Do not extend without a fresh cumulative reservation decision.
